title: The plutonium in hand, 1941 to 1945 (log scale)
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale, in micrograms: 0.5 micrograms of plutonium-239, the sample whose slow-neutron fission Kennedy, Seaborg, Segrè and Wahl measured in May 1941; 2.77 micrograms of plutonium oxide, the first weighing, on 10 September 1942; 20 micrograms of plutonium hydroxide in a capillary, September 1942; and about 6 kilograms, six thousand million micrograms, the core of the Fat Man bomb in August 1945. Data: Kennedy et al., Physical Review 70 (1946); Seaborg's Nobel lecture (1951); Wikipedia, Plutonium.
heading: PLUTONIUM IN HAND · MICROGRAMS · LOG SCALE
